pkg.summary: 길 잃은 어둠에 꺼지지 않는 등불이 되어 너를 비추다
pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and gentle ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced early)

어둠 속에 길을 잃을 때
멀리 빛나는 별 하나 없어
흐릿한 그림자만 네 곁에 남아

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with gayageum soft plucks, subtle janggu rhythm building warmth)

내 손을 잡아줘
네가 넘어지지 않게 hold on tight
찬바람이 얼굴을 스칠 때
길 끝은 보이지 않을 때

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising gently, ajaeng glissando, percussion slowly layering, taepyeongso soft warm tease)

내 목소리 들어봐
내가 곁에 있는 걸 feel my light

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation adding tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with soaring bright melody, gayageum rhythm cutting clean)

내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 light your way
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게 tonight

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal leading with emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring warmly)

내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 널 비춰줄게
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding depth and reassurance)

작은 희망조차도 멀리 숨을 때
내 목소리 들어봐 stay with me
네가 넘어지지 않게 내가 지켜줄게

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low stabs, taepyeongso short bright motifs)

Yo, lost in the dark, shadows closing in
No stars above, but I won't let you fall again
My voice your guide, like lantern in the night
Ajaeng deep cry, taepyeongso burning bright
Bass hit heavy, feel the Joseon light
I'll be your flame, keep you shining through the fight

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring trills, full percussion explosion, female bright adlib)

내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 light your way
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게 tonight

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 널 비춰줄게
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게
내가 너의 발길에 등불이 되어줄게
꺼지지 않는 빛으로 light your way
흔들리는 마음도 다 잡아줄게
내가 너의 등불이 될게

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air and lingering gayageum harmonics, whispered male "I'll be your light... always")
pkg.sunoStyle: Korean traditional fusion EDM with afrobeat groove. Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing. Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick. Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm. Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance. Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant. Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap. Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM. Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe. Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable. Emotion line: tender unbreakable vow to become an eternal lantern on a cold moonlit Joseon path, bright female lead carrying soft resolve while deep male rap anchors the darkness.
